Backstory/how we got here: A month ago my son had 2000 random pokemon cards in all kinds of random boxes all over his room. He would spend hours reading them. Studying them. Organizing them.  My husband and I decided to take him to a local TCG event.  The week that pitch black came out. He immediately participated in a “rip til you hit” for pitch black and he was HOOKED. He talked to several of the venders there about their sets and master setting and decided to buy the pitch black ETB before leaving.   After the ETB it was game over.  All he cares to watch is pokemon cards. Not just pitch black. Every set. Every card. He has loved every part of learning about this hobby.  He has been saving money from different garage sales we have had and today I let him buy a booster box. Please follow as we go through this box and help me support this fun little hobby of his. also any tips about master setting/ collecting are super welcome!! #pokemon #pokemoncards #pitchblack #fyp
